Rook uses this payload only as an ffmpeg.exe subprocess for generated-video
poster, start_frame, and end_frame sidecar extraction.

The release source bundle is generated during release prep by
scripts\ffmpeg\build-rook-ffmpeg.ps1 and must be published beside the Rook
installer. Release validation requires the generated
rook-ffmpeg-source-bundle-manifest.json and verifies the source archive,
signature metadata, configure allowlist, bundle SHA-256, required bundle
contents, and extraction smoke fixtures.

License: LICENSE.zlib.txt. The source bundle includes this archive, metadata,
license and linker map proving selection of the owned static archive.
